# ubuntu_file_info Data Source

Reads file_info data via the hostsession.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "ubuntu_file_info" "example" {
  target = var.host
  path = "/etc/terraform-provider-linux/managed.conf"
}
```
## Argument Reference

The data source accepts the following arguments:

- `path` (Required, string) - Absolute path to query.
- `port` (Optional, Computed, int64) - Target port for this data source. Overrides provider default_target.port.
- `run_as` (Optional, string) - Run file metadata reads as this user.
- `target` (Optional, Computed, string) - Target host or address for this data source. Overrides provider default_target.target.
- `transport` (Optional, Computed, string) - Transport for this data source. The current provider surface supports ssh.

## Attribute Reference

In addition to the configured arguments, this data source exports the following attributes:

- `digest` (string) - Content digest, including the algorithm tag.
- `exists` (bool) - Whether the file exists.
- `group` (string) - File group.
- `id` (string) - Unique identifier for this data source.
- `mode` (string) - File permission mode.
- `mtime_unix` (int64) - Last modification time as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
- `owner` (string) - File owner.
- `size` (int64) - File size in bytes.
